weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the limitations of the proposed method, particularly regarding non-monotone loss functions.
The paper lacks a comprehensive comparison with existing methods, which could better contextualize the contributions.
Some theoretical results, such as the factor of 2 in the lower bound, are stated as open questions without sufficient exploration in the main text.
strengths: The paper presents a novel extension of conformal prediction that broadens its applicability to various loss functions.
The theoretical guarantees provided for the proposed method are rigorous and well-founded.
Empirical results across multiple domains demonstrate the practical effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.
